Finite termination and matching output of recursive compatible-NVB conformity closure; only the closure guarantee is used, not a complexity claim.

Exact positive/zero/negative orientation signs, including degeneracies, for rational polygon vertices after positive common-denominator scaling. The batch-7 Step-1 record is hash-current and closed; independent review remains due.

Local result proving that the H2 nodal P1 interpolant of an H1-zero function has consistent cell values, zero boundary edge values, and belongs to H1-zero; it derives the boundary trace from global H1 zero extension and the two-sided half-space trace.
